facts.activity_file: testing for dead and applying earths

control_failures.control_label: earth leakage and protection setting integrity

facts.site: Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility
facts.title: corrective action - critical control at TX-3002

response.consequence: The recorded outcome was no injury or loss. The potential outcome was rated 1 against the site's consequence scale, above the 0 actually realised.

defences.finding: Control EARTH_LEAKAGE_PROTECTION: the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective, and the ICAM investigation classified this as an absent or failed defence.

recommendations: Restore the earth leakage and protection setting integrity on TX-3002 and record the critical control verification before this task is next authorised.
response.sequence: Work was under way in controlling access to energised apparatus, specifically testing for dead and applying earths. TX-3002 (switchgear and transformers) is in service for plant HV/LV distribution. The task proceeded during start-up after maintenance while the earth leakage and protection setting integrity was never verified as effective. The thermal energy involved is held as hot surface, and the recorded presentation was burn, ignition, scald.
response.summary: On 19 January 2016 a corrective action on TX-3002 at Marrindal Concentrator and Hydrocarbon Transfer Facility was reviewed against the critical control it was raised to restore.
